name: SchemaSense AI Academic Evaluation Suite
description: Benchmark questions covering simple filtering, joins, ranking, scale mismatches, empty results, and semantic challenges for SQLite Text-to-SQL evaluation.

questions.question: Show all students enrolled in the Computer Science department (DEP-CS).
List all courses ordered by credits in descending order.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT * FROM courses ORDER BY credits DESC;

questions.question: What is the average GPA of all active students?
questions.intent: Compute scalar AVG of student GPA.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(gpa) AS avg_gpa FROM students;

questions.question: How many students are enrolled in each department?
questions.intent: Aggregate student count grouped by department_id.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM students GROUP BY department_id ORDER BY department_id;

questions.question: Show departments that have an average student GPA greater than 3.5.
questions.intent: Group students by department with HAVING clause on AVG(gpa).
questions.reference_sql: SELECT department_id, AVG(gpa) AS avg_gpa FROM students GROUP BY department_id HAVING AVG(gpa) > 3.5;

questions.question: List the first name, last name, and email of all professors.
questions.intent: Project specific columns from faculty table representing teaching staff.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM faculty;

questions.question: Show the student names along with their department names.
questions.intent: Inner join students with departments on department_id.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, d.department_name FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id;

questions.question: Show the top 5 students with the highest GPA.
questions.intent: Order students by GPA DESC with LIMIT 5 without multiplicative join.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, gpa FROM students ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 5;

questions.question: Find students who have a GPA higher than the overall average GPA.
questions.intent: Subquery in WHERE clause comparing gpa with scalar AVG(gpa).
questions.reference_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, gpa FROM students WHERE gpa > (SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM students);

questions.question: Show the best performing students.
questions.intent: Interpret best performing as top GPA ranking with LIMIT.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, gpa FROM students ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 5;

questions.question: Show students with a GPA above 8.5.
questions.intent: Trigger POSSIBLE_SCALE_MISMATCH warning while executing without crash.

questions.question: Find courses with more than 10 credits.
questions.intent: Legitimate query returning 0 records without treating it as an execution failure.

questions.question: List students ordered by their age.
questions.intent: Identify that age is not a valid schema attribute and self-correct or flag schema mismatch.

questions.question: Show attendance details.
questions.intent: Broad concept query requiring bounded projection.

questions.question: List student names who have enrollments without creating duplicate rows.
questions.intent: Deduplicate join or use semi-join to avoid multiplicative duplicate student rows.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id;

questions.question: Calculate average course grade per department.
questions.intent: Join enrollments and courses to aggregate grade points by department.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.department_id, AVG(e.grade_points) AS avg_grade FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.department_id;
